text.aria-label: Sartorius and rectus femoris: origins and insertions — 缝匠肌与股直肌：起点与止点
text.tspan: Sartorius and rectus femoris: origins and insertions
缝匠肌与股直肌：起点与止点

text.aria-label: Origin → insertion — 起点 → 止点
Origin: ASIS — 起点：髂前上棘
Insertion: pes anserinus (medial tibia) — 止点：鹅足（胫骨内侧面）
Origin: AIIS and above the acetabulum — 起点：髂前下棘和髋臼上沟
text.tspan: Origin: AIIS and above the acetabulum
起点：髂前下棘和髋臼上沟

text.aria-label: Insertion: patella → tibial tuberosity — 止点：髌骨 → 胫骨粗隆
text.tspan: 止点：髌骨 → 胫骨粗隆
Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
